+    @staticmethod
+    def _clip(value: str, limit: int) -> str:
+        """
+        按字符数截断文本，超出时以省略号结尾，总长不超过 limit。
+        """
+        if not value or len(value) <= limit:

+    @staticmethod
+    def _limit_embed_content(
+        title: str, description: str, fields: List[Dict[str, str]]
+    ) -> Tuple[str, str, List[Dict[str, str]]]:
+        """
+        截断 Discord 嵌入消息内容，保证各文本字段及总长度均不超限。
+
+        :param title: 嵌入消息标题
+        :param description: 嵌入消息描述
+        :param fields: 按显示顺序排列的字段
+        :return: 截断后的标题、描述和字段
+        """
+        title = Discord._clip(title, EMBED_TITLE_LIMIT)
+        description = Discord._clip(description, EMBED_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT)
+        fields = [
+            {
+                "name": Discord._clip(field["name"], EMBED_FIELD_NAME_LIMIT),
+                "value": Discord._clip(field["value"], EMBED_FIELD_VALUE_LIMIT),
+            }
+            for field in fields[:EMBED_FIELD_COUNT_LIMIT]
+        ]
+
+        def _total() -> int:
+            """
+            计算嵌入消息中计入总长度上限的字符数。
+            """
+            return (
+                len(title)
+                + len(description)
+                + sum(len(field["name"]) + len(field["value"]) for field in fields)
+            )
+
+        overflow = _total() - EMBED_TOTAL_LIMIT
+        if overflow > 0 and description:
+            description = Discord._clip(
+                description, max(len(description) - overflow, 1)
+            )
+        while fields and _total() > EMBED_TOTAL_LIMIT:
+            fields.pop()
+        return title, description, fields

+"""
+验证 Discord 嵌入消息构建时遵守平台长度上限。
+"""
+
+from app.modules.discord.discord import Discord
+from app.schemas.types import MessageType
+
+
+def _embed_total(embed) -> int:
+    """
+    统计嵌入消息中计入 6000 字符上限的全部文本长度。
+    """
+    total = len(embed.title or "") + len(embed.description or "")
+    for field in embed.fields:
+        total += len(field.name) + len(field.value)
+    return total
+
+
+def test_long_title_and_description_are_truncated():
+    """
+    超长标题和描述应被截断到 256 / 4096 字符并以省略号结尾。
+    """
+    embed = Discord._build_embed(
+        title="题" * 1000, text="文" * 9000, image=None, link=None
+    )
+
+    assert len(embed.title) == 256
+    assert embed.title.endswith("…")
+    assert len(embed.description) == 4096
+    assert embed.description.endswith("…")
+
+
+def test_long_field_name_and_value_are_truncated():
+    """
+    超长字段名和值分别被截断到 256 和 1024 字符。
+    """
+    embed = Discord._build_embed(
+        title="标题",
+        text="名" * 3000 + "：" + "值" * 3000,
+        image=None,
+        link=None,
+        mtype=MessageType.Download,
+    )
+
+    assert len(embed.fields) == 1
+    assert len(embed.fields[0].name) == 256
+    assert embed.fields[0].name.endswith("…")
+    assert len(embed.fields[0].value) == 1024
+    assert embed.fields[0].value.endswith("…")
+
+
+def test_field_count_and_total_length_are_limited():
+    """
+    字段最多 25 个，整条嵌入合计不超过 6000 字符。
+    """
+    text = "\n".join(f"字段{i}：{'值' * 900}" for i in range(40))
+    embed = Discord._build_embed(
+        title="标题",
+        text="描述" * 2000 + "\n" + text,
+        image=None,
+        link=None,
+        mtype=MessageType.Download,
+    )
+
+    assert len(embed.fields) <= 25
+    assert _embed_total(embed) <= 6000
+
+
+def test_short_content_is_unchanged():
+    """
+    未超限的内容保持原样。
+    """
+    embed = Discord._build_embed(
+        title="标题",
+        text="名称：值\n说明",
+        image=None,
+        link=None,
+        mtype=MessageType.Download,
+    )
+
+    assert embed.title == "标题"
+    assert embed.description == "说明"
+    assert [(f.name, f.value) for f in embed.fields] == [("名称", "值")]
